summary: Make TinyDB's JSONStorage writes crash-safe so a process killed mid-write can't leave a truncated db.json. So far the cause is found: writes overwrite the file in place.
narrative: The owner reported that a service was OOM-killed mid-write and left a truncated db.json that TinyDB could no longer open. The only recorded work so far is a diagnosis (observation #1): JSONStorage.write overwrites db.json in place, so a crash partway through leaves a half-written file. No fix, PR or confirmation appears in memory yet.

milestones.text: Owner reported a truncated db.json after an OOM kill and asked for crash-safe JSONStorage writes
Diagnosed that JSONStorage.write overwrites db.json in place, so it is not crash-safe

evidence: Prompt 1 and observation #1 in project tinydb; memory has no later activity.
